# Quotiva

A lightweight, multilingual inspirational quotes library for JavaScript and TypeScript.

## Features

- English and Arabic quote collections
- Stable, language-independent tags
- Filtering by language, tag, and author
- Unicode-aware search across text, authors, and tags
- Deterministic UTC quote of the day
- Immutable results and metadata
- TypeScript declarations and zero runtime dependencies
- RTL metadata for Arabic

## Installation

```sh
npm install quotiva
```

## Quick Start

```ts
import { getRandomQuote } from "quotiva";

const quote = getRandomQuote();

if (quote) {
  console.log(quote.quote);
  console.log(quote.author);
}
```

No-match operations return `undefined` for `getRandomQuote` and `getDailyQuote`, and an empty array for collection and search operations.

## Languages

```ts
import { getRandomQuote, getSupportedLanguages } from "quotiva";

const quote = getRandomQuote({ language: "ar" });
const languages = getSupportedLanguages();
// [{ code: "en", name: "English", nativeName: "English", direction: "ltr" },
//  { code: "ar", name: "Arabic", nativeName: "العربية", direction: "rtl" }]
```

Language codes are deliberately part of the public type model. Arabic quote text is preserved as Arabic source text; it is not presented as a translation of an attributed historical quotation.

## Tags

Tags are normalized, lowercase English identifiers in every language:

```ts
import { getRandomQuote, getTags } from "quotiva";

const quote = getRandomQuote({ tag: "discipline" });
const tags = getTags({ language: "ar" });
```

## Filtering

```ts
import { getQuotes, getQuotesByAuthor, getQuotesByTag } from "quotiva";

const focused = getQuotes({ language: "en", tag: "wisdom" });
const byAuthor = getQuotesByAuthor("Lao Tzu", { language: "en" });
const byTag = getQuotesByTag("success", { language: "en" });
```

Filters are case-insensitive for tags and authors. Results are returned in dataset order.

## Searching

```ts
import { searchQuotes } from "quotiva";

const results = searchQuotes("الحياة", { language: "ar" });
const EnglishResults = searchQuotes("life", { language: "en" });
```

Search is case-insensitive where applicable and checks quote text, author names, and tags. An empty or whitespace-only query returns `[]`.

## Daily Quote

```ts
import { getDailyQuote } from "quotiva";

const quote = getDailyQuote({ language: "ar" });
```

The daily quote uses the current UTC calendar date and the filtered collection. The same date and filters produce the same quote in Node.js and browsers without persistence or network access.

## API Reference

- `getRandomQuote(options?): Quote | undefined` returns one random matching quote.
- `getQuotes(options?): Quote[]` returns all matching quotes.
- `getQuotesByAuthor(author, options?): Quote[]` returns quotes by an author.
- `getQuotesByTag(tag, options?): Quote[]` returns quotes with a tag.
- `getAuthors(options?): string[]` returns unique authors in deterministic order.
- `getTags(options?): string[]` returns unique normalized tags in deterministic order.
- `getSupportedLanguages(): Language[]` returns language metadata.
- `searchQuotes(query, options?): Quote[]` searches text, authors, and tags.
- `getQuoteCount(options?): number` counts matching quotes.
- `getDailyQuote(options?): Quote | undefined` returns the deterministic UTC daily quote.
- `isSupportedLanguage(language): boolean` checks a language code at runtime.

`QuoteFilterOptions` supports `language`, `tag`, and `author`. `Quote` contains `quote`, `author`, `language`, and readonly `tags`.

## TypeScript

Quotiva ships strict TypeScript declarations with the package. The public model is immutable from the type system's perspective, and runtime results are defensively cloned so changing returned arrays or tags never changes the internal collection.

## Adding Languages

Language support is registry-driven. Add a dataset under `src/data`, register its metadata in `src/languages.ts`, and add the collection to `src/data/index.ts`. Core filtering, search, discovery, and daily selection do not need language-specific changes.

## Contributing

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for development and quote contribution rules.

## Data and Attribution

The collection favors public-domain historical material, traditional sayings, and quotations that can be responsibly redistributed. Attribution is retained as supplied and should be verified before changes are proposed. A traditional saying is labeled as such rather than assigned to a famous author. Contributors must not copy proprietary quote databases or submit uncertain attributions.

## Runtime Compatibility

The package is ESM-only and targets modern Node.js and browser tooling. It works with Node.js 18 or later and modern bundlers such as Vite, React, NestJS, and Nx when configured for ESM.

## Zero Dependencies

Quotiva has no runtime dependencies. TypeScript is used only during development and packaging.
